approved_by: user 2026-10-05 ('Approve all three ... make it symmetric and fair'), with the clarifications applied below
freeze_rule: Nothing in this file changes after freezing; changes go in an amendment. Implementation is smoke-tested on 999xxxxx seeds only. No episode on the confirmatory block before this file is committed.
paper_question: Are A and B actually behaviourally different? (independent of REPLICATION_2V2_DUAL_BRANCH_V1 and Z_INTERVENTION_2V2_V1; results are not combined)
classification: Pre-registered behavioural measurement. Read-only rollouts of existing sealed checkpoints. No training, no action change.
symmetry: A and B are treated identically: same seeds, same cells, same metrics, two-sided tests, no presumed direction for any metric. Both systems use the same block and the same analysis.

Ours.what: 2v2 dual-branch teachers (DUAL_BRANCH_ROLE_COMPOSITE_V1), CLOSEST_DEFENDS k=1, roles fixed per episode, H_r=8; DEFEND slots -> pi_X final, ATTACK slots -> exported attack branch

Fully_Shared_z_r.what: 2v2 Stage-4 student pi(a | o, z, r), z forced per episode

design.cells: for each system: strategy in {A, B} x pole in {A, B}; deterministic policies

seeds.shared: every cell of both systems uses the same 128 seeds (same seed = same start)

design.snapshot: read-only state snapshot at every decision tick, before env.step; the chosen macro is read from the action actually sent to the env

statistical_unit: THE EPISODE (one seed in one cell). Ticks and agents are never treated as independent samples: each metric is first reduced to ONE number per episode, and every test pairs the two strategies' episodes by seed (n = 128 pairs per pole).

metrics_frozen.M1_home_share: per tick with >= 1 active blue agent (alive, untagged): (number of active blue agents not carrying and within 4.5 cells of own flag home) / (number of active blue agents); episode value = mean over those ticks. 4.5 = the frozen composition-probe instrument R_POS.
metrics_frozen.M2_forward_share: per tick with >= 1 active blue agent: (number of active blue agents on the enemy half, i.e. the side of the midline x = cols/2 containing the enemy flag home) / (number active); episode value = mean over those ticks.
metrics_frozen.M3_enemy_flag_distance: per tick with >= 1 active blue agent: mean distance (cells) from active blue agents to the enemy flag's current position; episode value = mean over those ticks.
metrics_frozen.M4_spacing: per tick where both blue agents are active: distance (cells) between them; episode value = mean over those ticks. If an episode has no such tick, M4 is undefined for that episode and its seed pair is dropped from that pole's M4 test; the number dropped is reported.
metrics_frozen.M5_first_grab_tick: decision tick (0-based) at which a blue agent first picks up the enemy flag. If no blue grab occurs in the episode (however the episode ends), the value is the episode horizon R2.MAX_STEPS = 240. Grab occurrence (0/1) is reported descriptively alongside.
metrics_frozen.M6_macro_distribution: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY. Per-episode share of each of the 5 macros among blue decisions, reported per strategy x pole x system with 95% intervals. Excluded from all tests and from the signature count.

analysis_frozen.difference: for system S, pole p, metric m in M1-M5: d_s = m(A on p, seed s) - m(B on p, seed s); D_m(p) = mean over seeds of d_s
analysis_frozen.p_value: two-sided paired sign-flip permutation test on the seed-level d_s (20000 random sign flips, rng 7)
analysis_frozen.interval: 95% paired bootstrap interval of D_m(p) over seeds (n = 20000, rng 7, as eval_hog_psp_v3._mean_ci); reported, not used for the decision
analysis_frozen.test_family: per system, exactly 10 tests: M1-M5 x pole A, pole B. Holm step-down at family-wise alpha 0.05 within that family. The two systems are separate families.
analysis_frozen.signature_definition: metric m is a STRATEGY SIGNATURE of system S when D_m(A) and D_m(B) have the same sign AND both pole tests are rejected after Holm
analysis_frozen.decision_rule: behaviourally distinct strategies are supported for system S when at least 2 of M1-M5 are strategy signatures. Fully Shared+z+r PRESERVES a signature when that metric is a signature for both Ours and Fully Shared+z+r with the same sign.
analysis_frozen.opponent_effect: m(X on A) - m(X on B) for each strategy, descriptive only
analysis_frozen.reporting: mean effects with 95% intervals for every metric, both poles, both systems, plus Holm-adjusted p-values; no metric is dropped

not_evidence: wins and scores are recorded for traceability; this experiment makes no performance claim
launch: after the 4v4 Stage-4 chain finishes (user ordering)
